releaseNotes:
- Interrupted Manga Fast Lane runs can now resume from their exact run directory without starting duplicate work
- Content Studio now makes publishing conflicts and rollback state explicit before any write
- Fashion Look search stays isolated to the current asset, so parallel searches no longer replace each other's results
- Agent recovery reports the real failure and resumes safely instead of implying that your model changed
- Creator sign-in, command-line workflows, and external-agent diagnostics are more reliable across IDE restarts
- Beta and stable updates now preserve one verified build across macOS and Windows promotion
releaseNotesZh:
- 漫画 Fast Lane 中断后可从原运行目录准确恢复，不会重复启动任务
- Content Studio 现在会在写入前明确展示发布冲突与回滚状态
- Fashion Look 搜索现在按当前素材隔离，并行搜索不会再互相覆盖结果
- Agent 恢复现在会如实说明故障并安全继续，不再误导为模型已切换
- 创作者登录、命令行工作流与外部 Agent 诊断在 IDE 重启后更加可靠
- Beta 与 stable 更新现在会在 macOS 和 Windows 晋升过程中保持同一份已验证构建
